brief.product_concept: A payment system that lets AI agents pay other AI agents for services in microtransactions, settled in cryptocurrency. Source: docs/founder_ideas_examples.md, Idea B.
brief.target_user: Developers of AI agents that buy or sell services (data lookups, model calls, tool use)
quality_needs: Parsed quotes match the request exactly (service, quantity, max price)
Anomaly explanations cite the triggering signals
Summaries never state facts not in the transaction record

ai_features.description: Parse an agent's service request into a structured quote (text to JSON), once per transaction. Revenue per use = $0.02 average transaction value x 1% gateway take rate, both assumed.

rubric_checks.description: quote is a JSON object with service, quantity and max_price_usd
parsed quantity matches the request exactly (200)
parsed max price matches the request exactly ($0.40 total)

ai_features.description: Explain a flagged transaction (1% of transactions)
ai_features.example_input:
SYNTHETIC transaction record for testing. Fictional agents, IDs and amounts.
tx_id: tx_SYN_7f3a91
timestamp_utc: 2026-10-24T03:14:07Z
payer_agent: agt_SYN_buyer_0412 (registered 2026-08-02; 30-day median payment $0.021; 30-day volume 9,840 transactions)
payee_agent: agt_SYN_seller_9c77 (registered 2026-10-24T01:05:00Z)
service: geocoding lookup; quantity 15; quoted unit price $0.020
amount: $0.300 USDC on a layer-2 network; gateway fee $0.003
settlement: confirmed in 4 s
anomaly_signals:
1. amount_vs_median: $0.300 is 14.3x the payer's 30-day median payment ($0.021).
2. new_payee: the payee registered 2 h 9 min before this transaction and has no prior transactions with any payer.
3. velocity: 37 payments from this payer to this payee in the 90 s before this transaction; the payer's usual peak is 6 payments per minute across all payees.
risk_score: 0.87 (hold threshold 0.75); status: held for review

ai_features.description: Dispute or receipt summary, on demand (0.1% of transactions)
ai_features.example_input:
SYNTHETIC dispute thread for testing. Fictional agents, IDs and amounts.
tx_id: tx_SYN_52c0de; buyer paid $0.40 USDC for 200 geocoding lookups (quote: max $0.40 total, $0.002 per lookup).
[2026-10-24T09:12:03Z] agt_SYN_buyer_0412: 23 of 200 lookups returned error GEO_404. Requesting a refund for 23 lookups ($0.046).
[09:12:41Z] agt_SYN_seller_9c77: 15 of the 23 had malformed input (missing postcode), which our terms exclude. 8 failed on our side; we can refund those 8 ($0.016).
[09:13:20Z] agt_SYN_buyer_0412: All inputs were validated against your published schema v2, where postcode is optional.
[09:14:02Z] agt_SYN_seller_9c77: Confirmed, schema v2 marks postcode optional. We will refund all 23 lookups.
[09:14:30Z] agt_SYN_buyer_0412: Accepted. Please reference tx_SYN_52c0de.
[09:15:11Z] gateway: refund of $0.046 USDC issued, ref rf_SYN_0019; dispute closed.
